notes.title: Update 0.13
notes.content:
This update adds a lot of new buildings and updates some old ones.

First of all we added a new giant building which will be a orphanage you can explore soon!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41727819/65c1c7ce363f72d36caed05567020397ccb9de7b.png[/img]

We also added a little bridge.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41727819/e1a1b3f3d0c6cfb82c0ba9ee8be587d901d8a1c6.png[/img]

???
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41727819/5088d318c2c4b380d3c14b07c54797b5ce9086a3.png[/img]

The map is nearly done, soon we will start creating the first real events in-game and also from now on all the updates will be translated in also German and Turkish.

Your [b]Luzio[/b]

notes.title: Update 0.12
notes.content:
In the [b]0.12[/b] update there are not many changes, I meanly updated the [b]main menu[/b]!

I now added the language tab to the game!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41727819/d680d421e9f47b56ba98e24bbe27d6b048b20182.png[/img]

I also fixed the shadows in the [b]Castle Petrus[/b] play test

notes.title: Update 0.11.1
notes.content:
In this update I added a little playtest for a new map I'm working on. (This map wont replace anything.)

There is a new button for the playtest in the main menu!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41727819/0bad1c8aae58d04e37aac15f3532cf997c93f11d.png[/img]

notes.content:

???

Added alot of sound effects!

notes.title: Update 0.10
notes.content:
In the 0.10 update I added alot new changes to the main menu and some little map changes.

Added a selection screen for the episode. (Soon called Chapter)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41727819/4a528c8a50c184ccb515bd8eaddf9e4d1f140ce5.png[/img]

Added the credits section.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41727819/8911fb6d38931b98c17b2a89865a970e00615310.png[/img]

New mushroom on the map.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41727819/e76762aa2559161e2a27881f01a0d01181455ce1.png[/img]

Updated the house at the spawn.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41727819/21ce224c90d541a4103662f7312df7c2ab54772a.png[/img]

Also fixed the lantern rotation the player holds.

notes.title: Update 0.9.1
notes.content: In this small update I corrected the lighting and shadows for the low quality. Before this update, low quality had no light.

notes.title: Update 0.9
notes.content:
In the 0.9 update I added a cave to the map you have to go threw!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41727819/21106e1dc8b61aaaa4c0e49af36fd1544b547024.png[/img]

I also added stars to the sky.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41727819/8c106b9485170b9c1ec96cd2002897689d516a72.png[/img]

notes.title: Update 0.8.1
notes.content: In this little update I maxed out the shadow for the high resolution. In the following days I will also release a update that fixes the light in the low resolution.

notes.content:
In update [b]0.8[/b] I updated the settings menu and added sections for volume, video and languages.
